description: Wan2.1 T2V 1.3B at 720x1280 / 77 frames on 4x L40S WITH torch.compile on each transformer block. Tests whether kernel fusion via Inductor recovers the elementwise-dominated time observed in nsys (109k aten::to per generation in DenoisingStage).
